spans.s: dīpa-mālā, cf. tīpa-mālai (SITI), the string of lights hung in temples; same as śara-vil̤akku.
dīpa-pūjā (EI 9), dīpa and pūjā wrongly taken as a compound word of special significance.
dīpāvalī (EI 5; CII 4), name of a festival; the festival of lights; cf. dīp-otsava.

dīp-otsava (EI 11, 32), same as dīpāvalī, the festival^1 of lights.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
